programme.desc: After a training accident causes a glitch in Chloe's powers, Max and Phoebe look for a cure. After Max thinks he's solved the issue, he allows Chloe to attend a party with friends, but his treatment creates brand new powers Chloe can't control.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 Ep.535: Game of Phones
programme.desc: When a young girl chains herself outside of Junk-N-Stuff, Kid Danger and Captain Man are forced to help find her beloved phone. While on a stakeout, they unexpectedly run across some familiar faces with a devious plan they weren't prepared for.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 Ep.536: Escape Room
programme.desc: Kid Danger and Captain Man are tricked into entering an escape room by a factory owner with a chip on his shoulder. They are trapped inside with two new kids, Mika and Miles, who are oddly good at solving the puzzles they need to answer to get out.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 Ep.207: Krampapalooza
programme.desc: Danger Force sees an opportunity to make money fast by hosting Swellview's hottest music festival, but they catch a case of the Kramps when Krampus threatens to ruin their plans.

programme.title: iCarly S1 Ep.115: iRue the Day
programme.desc: Spencer saves the life of the lead singer of The Plain White T’s and gets him to agree to go on iCarly. Strange things start going wrong in the middle of Carly, Sam, and Freddie’s webcast

programme.title: iCarly S1 Ep.116: iGot Detention
programme.desc: Sam gets detention on the night of iCarly’s 50th web show spectacular. Unable to do their normal webcast, Carly and Freddie do their best to get detention too so they can do the show from inside detention with Sam.

programme.title: Victorious S1 Ep.115: The Great Ping-Pong Scam
programme.desc: Tori discovers that her friends have been secretly going to a fancy restaurant instead of playing in an annual ping pong tournament.

programme.title: Sam & Cat S1 Ep.105: #BabySitterWar
programme.desc: When a babysitting client says, You're my favorite babysitter ever, Sam and Cat debate which one of them he meant. They compete for their new clients' affection to see who really is the best babysitter.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 Ep.104: Donnie Hangs Tough
programme.desc: It's a battle of the wits between Donnie and Bishop as he races through NYC's subway system to stop her evil Mechazoids. But how do you beat an AI that counters your every move?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 Ep.105: Bishop Makes Her Move
programme.desc: The origin of the woman called BISHOP! Why does she hate mutants? What is the secret of the Mechazoids? And exactly what happened the night the Turtles fell into Bishop's trap?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 Ep.317: Delivery of Doom / My Father the Boat
programme.desc: SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to make a delivery to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less. // When Mr. Krabs gets trapped inside of Pearl's new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 Ep.318: Who's Afraid of Mr. Snippers? / A Fish Called Sandy
programme.desc: Squidward and Plankton take to the stage to take down a common adversary. // To experience the ocean firsthand, Sandy swaps genes with a fish.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 Ep.319: Making Waves / Captain Quasar: The Next Iteration
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs and Plankton are forced to spend time together when they accidentally book the same room on a cruise. // SpongeBob and Bubble Bass butt heads over which version of Quasar is better.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.109: Party Party / Mica's Robot
programme.desc: Thinking she hasn't been invited to Bibi's party Jade sneaks in. // Mica doesn't finish his robot in time for the school science fair, so the Marsupilamis squeeze inside and operate it.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.110: Smile for the Camera / School invaders
programme.desc: Rosa installs security cameras at the park, and people hate being spied on. // When the Twins take the Marsupilamis to school, Stan spots Twister and claims a poisonous frog is loose to gain access.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S3 Ep.306: Pat-per Route / Day of the Dartfish
programme.desc: Patrick helps Squidward with his newspaper delivery job to compensate for injuring him. // In the midst of a typical day of scavenging, the Dartfish family discovers a thief in the Star home.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S3 Ep.307: Patty-Poo / Swaptoberfest
programme.desc: Patrick spawns an adorable mini-Patrick who quickly becomes the star of the show (until he outgrows the role). // The Star family celebrates the Klopnodian holiday Swaptoberfest by swapping identities with each other.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 Ep.118: A Space Affair to Remember
programme.desc: While Cecil and Bunny celebrate their anniversary in outer space, Patrick and Squidina throw a house party.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 Ep.310: Biscuit Ballyhoo / Student Driver Survivor
programme.desc: After the Science Scouts begin selling biscuits to fund a trip to Mars, Mr. Krabs joins the ring and turns it into a competition. // When a competitor threatens to shut down Mrs. Puff's boating school, she must rely on SpongeBob to stay in business.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S1 Ep.101: Thundercover
programme.desc: Max and Phoebe bring Chloe on an undercover mission to Secret Shores so she can experience life as a normal kid. When a new supervillain threat emerges, the trio must stay in town longer than they anticipated.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 Ep.207: Krampapalooza
programme.desc: Danger Force sees an opportunity to make money fast by hosting Swellview's hottest music festival, but they catch a case of the Kramps when Krampus threatens to ruin their plans.

programme.title: Henry Danger S3 Ep.317: Stuck In Two Holes
programme.desc: Whaaaat?!? Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole?!? Charlotte and Jasper better go help, 'cuz Schwoz is takin' a bean bath!

programme.title: The Loud House S1 Ep.111: The Butterfly Effect / The Green House
programme.desc: After spilling an experiment of Lisa's, Lincoln sets off a chain reaction that unravels the household. // In an effort to be more energy-efficient Lincoln rallies his family to stop using so much electricity.

programme.title: The Loud House S1 Ep.112: Along Came a Sister / Chore and Peace
programme.desc: Lincoln is given the responsibility of taking home his classes’ tarantula, but it gets loose and wreaks havoc! // Thinking he has the worst chores, Lincoln decides to go on strike until someone will swap chores with him.

programme.title: The Loud House S3 Ep.309: Missed Connection
programme.desc: Lori and Bobby worry that dating long-distance is causing them to lose their connection.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 Ep.212: The Incredible Shrinking Sponge / Sportz?
programme.desc: SpongeBob must figure out how to do his job after accidentally shrinking himself. // Squidward invents a new sport to get back at SpongeBob and Patrick for annoying him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 Ep.213: The Getaway / Lost and Found
programme.desc: When SpongeBob mistakes an escaped convict for his driving instructor, it's the new teacher who learns a lesson. // When Krabs sends him searching for a missing toy, SpongeBob finds himself lost... in the lost & found!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 Ep.276: Patrick the Mailman
programme.desc: Patrick crushes the mailman, so he and SpongeBob deliver the mail around Bikini Bottom.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 Ep.281: The Salty Sponge / Karen for Spot
programme.desc: SpongeBob works the grill at the toughest joint in town. // Karen looks after Spot while Plankton goes out of town.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S12 Ep.252: Mind the Gap / Dirty Bubble Returns
programme.desc: Squidward closes the gap in SpongeBob's teeth, which causes a dramatic and unexpected change in his demeanor. // The newly reformed Clean Bubble takes a dishwashing job at the Krusty Krab, where he is tempted by the grime.

programme.title: The Loud House S6 Ep.609: The Last Laugh / Driver's Dread
programme.desc: Luan thinks Mr. Coconuts is out for revenge when she replaces him with Lola in her act. // Hoping to drive out to the outlets to meet Lori, Leni ooks for alternative ways to get her driver's license.

programme.title: The Loud House S6 Ep.610: Bummer Camp / Sleepstakes
programme.desc: When Gramps struggles to run Camp Mastadon, the kids come to his rescue. //The Loud kids help Lana get over her fear of sleepovers.

programme.title: The Loud House S4 Ep.404: Face the Music with the Casagrandes / Pranks for the Memories with the Casagrandes
programme.desc: When Ronnie Anne discovers that each family member will perform for Hector's birthday, she turns to Sid for help. // Ronnie Anne's attempts to bond with her cool older cousin Carlota lead to a prank war against the boy cousins.

programme.title: The Loud House S6 Ep.612: Time Trap!
programme.desc: When the kids break Mom and Dad's priceless vase, they decide the only thing to do is go back in time to their wedding day, and prevent them from ever receiving it.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 Ep.213: The Getaway / Lost and Found
programme.desc: When SpongeBob mistakes an escaped convict for his driving instructor, it's the new teacher who learns a lesson. // When Krabs sends him searching for a missing toy, SpongeBob finds himself lost... in the lost & found!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 Ep.305: The Dirty Bubble Bass / Sheldon SquarePants
programme.desc: Bubble Bass and the Dirty Bubble team up to become Bikini Bottom's nastiest nefarious nuisance. // Plankton joins the SquarePants family in the hope of becoming closer to SpongeBob (and the secret formula).

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 Ep.200: Goodbye, Krabby Patty?
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs manufactures Krabby Patties on an industrial scale, but it drives a wedge between SpongeBob and Patrick.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 Ep.201: Sandy's Nutmare / Bulletin Board
programme.desc: Sandy creates the latest acorn-based food sensation, but her tree pays the price for her greed. // SpongeBob erects a community bulletin board in the Krusty Krab, but anonymous reviews posted on it lead to trouble.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 Ep.412: Visiting Vikings / It's Too Late...With Plankton
programme.desc: For Leif Erikson Day, Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times. // When the Stars go to the mountains, Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 Ep.413: Terror on Tape
programme.desc: The Stars watch a series of haunted video tapes.

programme.title: The Loud House S4 Ep.423: Wheel and Deal / Feast or Family
programme.desc: Lana wants to win a race car ride-along with her hero, so she and Lincoln enter to compete in a soap box derby. // When Luan must enroll in a culinary class, Dad uses it to share his passion for cooking with one of his kids.

programme.title: The Loud House S4 Ep.424: A Dark & Story Night / Sand Hassles
programme.desc: When the lights go out in the Loud House, the kids entertain themselves by taking turns telling parts of a story. // Lucy and the Morticians' Club try to thwart plans for a school field trip to the beach.

programme.title: The Loud House S9 Ep.908: Ship Wreckers / Writer's Retreat
programme.desc: Leni and Luna accidentally wreck Gramps boat when their small viewing party gets out of control. // Lucy struggles to come with ideas when she's given the opportunity to write an original story for the Royal Wood's Gazette.

programme.title: The Loud House S9 Ep.910: Gags To Riches / Sole Searching
programme.desc: After Luan pranks Grouse with a fake lottery ticket, she has to deal with the consequences of his massive shopping spree. // Lynn desperately searches for a popular brand of basketball shoes after she narrowly misses out on buying a pair.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 Ep.202: Summer of Secrets
programme.desc: Chloe must attend summer school, and Max is assigned to be her teacher. While they will be busy all summer, Phoebe decides to go solo on missions. She meets a new superhero named Captain Perfect, and discovers they make a good crime-fighting team.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 Ep.203: I Know What You Did This Summer
programme.desc: Max learns that Phoebe is working with Captain Perfect, and sets out to uncover the secret he is keeping. Chloe's crush invites her to a product launch party at Splat By The Sea, at the same time Jinx and Booch want her to protest outside the party.

programme.title: Danger Force S1 Ep.126: Drive Hard
programme.desc: Captain Man and Danger Force are hired to deliver a big budget Hollywood movie to its premiere but the producer warns them that rival studios and internet trolls are out to steal the movie.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 Ep.201: An Imposter Among Us
programme.desc: Rick Twitler returns with a new plan to control Mika's mind through a spooky VR video game. It's up to Danger Force to exer-cise the Rick Twitler out of Mika before they're all plunged back into the Dark Ages for good.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 Ep.518: Love Bytes
programme.desc: Things get a little buggy when Schwoz installs a new operating system on the Man Cave Computer designed to detect and eliminate threats all over Swellview.

programme.title: That Girl Lay Lay S2 Ep.216: Sorori-Tay-Tay
programme.desc: Trish's college sorority is reuniting for a mother-daughter step contest, and Lay Lay agrees to take over for Sadie, who is locked in a battle with Marky over their personal space.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S10 Ep.214: Patrick's Coupon / Out of the Picture
programme.desc: Patrick has a coupon for free ice cream, but he'll have to get to the store if he wants to use it! // Krabs buys Squidward's art, but to make a profit on his purchase he'll have to get the artist out of the picture!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S11 Ep.216: Cave Dwelling Sponge / The Clam Whisperer
programme.desc: When a prehistoric Sponge is unfrozen, he causes chaos all over town - and only SpongeBob can communicate with him! // When a flock of clams descend on Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob has to get them out before they ruin the whole town!

programme.title: The Loud House S6 Ep.624: Day of the Dad / Small Blunder
programme.desc: Lori struggles to make a good impression on Bobby's dad after accidentally pushing him into a puddle. // Desperate to have the best show-and-tell in class, Lily takes Lisa's shrink ray to school.

programme.title: The Loud House S3 Ep.313: Ruthless People
programme.desc: When the house is infested with termites, half the family stays with Pop Pop and the others with Aunt Ruth.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis S1 Ep.120: Mica's Wild Side/ Save the Tree

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 Ep.410: Safety Worst / De-Pat-ment Store
programme.desc: After yet another Star house disaster, the fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video. // Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S4 Ep.411: Doctor Patrick / Slumber Party Stars

programme.title: The Agenda
Dialogue
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
It is a prime time daily English talk show on CGTN.

It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on what’s relevant in China and the world.

programme.title: All The Goals: Giggs
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy every goal that Ryan Giggs scored for United, spanning his illustrious career at the club.

programme.title: All The Goals: Cantona
programme.desc: One of the most flamboyant players ever to play the game, King Eric cemented his name in United's history between 1992-97. The Frenchman helped the Reds to four league titles and two FA Cup wins.

programme.title: All The Goals: Van Nistelrooy
programme.desc: One of the Reds' greatest finishers, Ruud bagged 150 goals in 200 starts between 2001-2006. The stats speak for themselves, but his predatory instinct in front of goal is well worth reliving...

programme.title: All The Goals: Rooney
programme.desc: Sit back and enjoy all 253 of our former captain Wayne Rooney's goals that made him United's greatest goalscorer - from a debut hat-trick, to that overhead kick, to the record-breaking free-kick.

programme.title: All The Goals: Scholes
programme.desc: He scores goals...and lots of them in a fantastic career at United. From a fox in the box to some of the best strikes you'll ever see, this man has scored them all. A true legend.

programme.title: All The Goals: Beckham
programme.desc: A wonderfully gifted player, David Beckham could strike a ball like no other. With pin-point precision, his free-kicks were a speciality.

programme.title: All The Goals: Keane
programme.desc: The archetypal Captain, Roy was simply magnificent and one of the best midfielders of his generation. The Irish star grabbed many an important goal in his 13 years at Old Trafford.

programme.title: All The Goals: Rashford
programme.desc: Watch every goal of United Academy graduate Marcus Rashford as he enters the top 20 goalscorers in the club's history.

programme.title: All The Goals: Hughes
programme.desc: Both a great goalscorer and a scorer of great goals, Mark Hughes netted plenty of spectacular goals in his two spells at Old Trafford.

programme.title: All The Goals: Van Persie
programme.desc: One of Sir Alex's finest signings, Robin van Persie helped secure a historic 20th league title for the Reds. Relive all 58 of his United goals, including his stunning strike against Aston Villa.

programme.title: All The Goals: Berbatov
programme.desc: The Bulgarian striker oozed talent and scored some memorable goals in his 4 years at United. His strike rate measured more than a goal to every other start, an impressive achievement.

programme.title: All The Goals: Sheringham
programme.desc: Teddy was 31 when he joined the Old Trafford ranks in 1997. Blessed with a gifted footballing brain he played a pivotal role in helping the Reds secure the Treble in 1999.

programme.title: All The Goals: Kanchelskis
programme.desc: Flying Russian winger Andrei Kanchelskis enjoyed the most successful period of his career at Old Trafford, scoring crucial goals on the way to two Premier League titles.

programme.title: All The Goals: Carrick
programme.desc: See all of midfield maestro Michael Carrick's 24 goals during his trophy-laden career at Old Trafford.
